risk_if_not_implemented: Without Prohibit Training, personnel are more likely to make unsafe decisions, fall victim to social engineering, mishandle data or violate requirements. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Intellectual Property / Trade Secret Loss (R-EX-9), AI Data Confidentiality / Integrity / Provenance Loss (R-AI-2), Sensitive Data / Compliance Exposure from Unsanctioned AI Use (R-AI-4), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), Privacy Harm / Unauthorized Processing (R-IP-6), and most likely increases susceptibility to Artificial Intelligence & Autonomous Technologies (AAT) System Failure or Unintended Behavior (MT-13).

compensating_control_1.name: Statutory, Regulatory & Contractual Compliance
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the identification and implementation of relevant statutory, regulatory and contractual controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Statutory, Regulatory & Contractual Compliance (CPL-02) provides third-party oversight and contractual controls that compensates for the absence of Prohibit Training (AAT-18.6) by extending security obligations and monitoring third-party risk in lieu of direct primary control implementation. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Sensitive / Regulated Data Sharing Decisions
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize a process to assist users in making information sharing decisions to ensure data is appropriately protected.
compensating_control_2.justification: Sensitive / Regulated Data Sharing Decisions (DCH-08.1) provides threat intelligence and situational awareness that compensates for the absence of Prohibit Training (AAT-18.6) by providing early warning of threats and informing proactive security posture adjustments. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
